maxConcurrentJobsNote: Concurrency (BUG-006 wave, part B): how many live jobs POST /api/jobs runs at once; the busy 409 JOB_RUNNING only fires when that many are running. Validated at startup: integer in [1, 8]; absent defaults to 3. Set to 6 on 2026-10-31 so the final evaluation runs 3 Muse Spark 1.3 and 3 Spark Open jobs at once (separate providers). Each job keeps its own abort/wall-time budget and cost accumulator; the shared spend ledger holds every outstanding reservation against the stage cap, so concurrent jobs can never overshoot it.
maxInputTokensV2Note: S6-W input bound for the Stage 6 lesson flow (analysis v2 + kit component calls). The client's input bound counts BYTES (DEBT-003); S6-M measured the v2 analysis-repair request at 40.8k bytes on the largest current source, so 72,000 covers the 40,000-char source ceiling plus the ~15k-byte system prompt and schema (lead freeze addendum, 2026-10-29). v1 activity calls keep maxInputTokens 32,000. Validated at startup: integer, positive, <= the provider context window (1,048,576 for muse-spark-1.3, docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md).
approvedBudgetNote: meta: USD 150 participant credits, used only for live product test/demo runs (building is subscription-only). Live-run cap USD 100 (Calvin, 2026-10-31, for the final evaluation; was USD 50 from 2026-10-29, USD 10 from 2026-10-27). Others 0.
ledgerLockPortNote: Loopback port held while a process owns storage/ledger.jsonl (TASK-009 N-01). Fixed and below the Windows dynamic range 49152-65535 so it does not collide with ephemeral ports.
providerCapsUSDNote: OW-2 per-provider soft caps enforced by the spend ledger (packages/meta openLedger). meta-api must equal stageCapsUSD.stage2 (validated at startup); modal is capped separately: USD 80 of the USD 100 Modal hackathon credit (raised 2026-10-31 for the final evaluation; Calvin treats Modal credit as free tokens). A provider without a cap fails closed.
judgeCapUSDNote: Stage 10 slice A: the judging-period budget (USD) for jobs started under a judge access session (docs/specs/STAGE-10-navigation-and-access.md section A). Calvin 2026-11-02: USD 50. Validated at startup: finite, > 0, <= the smaller of the provider caps' sum and stageCapsUSD.stage2; absent means 50 (clamped to that bound). It is an application-level budget on top of the ledger caps, which still fail closed on every call.
modalBaseUrlNote: OW-2 Modal Shared Endpoint base URL for Muse Spark Open (not a secret; copied from the Modal dashboard). Validated at startup as a plain https URL without credentials/query/fragment. Auth comes from MODAL_PROXY_TOKEN in the environment, never from this file.
